This compound further targets the Synaptic vesicular amine transporter, indicating a chain of molecular interactions. The scores from the paths suggest a consistent and plausible link between Yunaconitine and the transporter, though the exact mechanism of action remains partially inferred. The presence of multiple targets along this pathway highlights the complexity of the interaction network, with each step potentially contributing to the overall effect on the transporter. The integration of these findings supports the hypothesis that Yunaconitine may influence the transporter through these intermediate targets, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct relationship.
